title: Continuous Glucose Time-in-Range
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings measurements (`withings:measure`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export or Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, and Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dexcom:egv
| eval band=case(glucose_mgdl<70,"low",glucose_mgdl<=180,"in range",1=1,"high")
| stats count by band
| eventstats sum(count) as total
| eval pct=round(100*count/total,1)
description: Calculates what fraction of the day your glucose stays within the healthy target band, the headline metric clinicians use for glucose management.
value: Time-in-range is a more meaningful goal than a single reading; quantifying it helps anyone managing glucose see progress clearly.
implementation: Ingest continuous-glucose-monitor values into `index=personal`; schedule daily and track the in-range percentage over time.
visualization: Pie or bar chart of time spent low, in range, and high.
grandmaExplanation: It works out how much of the day your blood sugar stayed in the healthy zone.
